Mines Officer Faces Corruption Case, Assets Worth ₹100 Crore Seized

The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) has registered a disproportionate assets case against the Assistant Director of the Mines and Geology Department in Bhupalpally. During raids, assets estimated to be worth ₹100 crore were seized. The officer is accused of accumulating wealth beyond his known sources of income.
